subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept library-only termination/GSAR primitives now, relocate them to an agent-core or plugin-facing API, or park this work behind the linked feature issue until the sessions_send integration and trusted-evidence contract are designed?
rationale: The patch is intentionally unused groundwork in a core agents path, while repository vision keeps core lean and treats production message-delivery gating as an owner-reviewed product and safety boundary.

options.title: Defer Core Merge
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue as the tracker until an owner-approved sessions_send or agent-core API shape exists.

options.title: Accept Core Groundwork
options.body: Land the unused primitives after targeted hard-bound proof, explicitly owning the dormant core surface and future integration risk.

options.title: Relocate The Surface
options.body: Move the primitives to an agent-core or plugin-facing API if maintainers want extension authors to own policy composition first.

recommendation.title: Defer Core Merge
recommendation.body: Keep the linked feature issue as the tracker until an owner-approved sessions_send or agent-core API shape exists.
